headline.text: L1 Sollich 4 was down *multiple times* through the window on THG failure, dark caramel, and a spatula-in-slitter incident — blades replaced by 06:49 but tunnel issues still being corrected at shift end.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 4 had the roughest day: THG finger broke at 23:56 requiring a level 2 clean, dark caramel flagged and held, watery batch with unmixed sugar, then a metal spatula pulled into the slitter at 06:13 requiring blade replacement. Tunnel 1 belt and rails found dirty and misaligned at 08:30. Sollich 2 ran caramel cluster all shift but had two belt issues mid-morning (C1 and Matrix 8) that weren't clearly resolved. Sollich 3 completed the SRS order and changed to PRS, with one brief Matrix 5 pouch jam cleared in 17 minutes. Sollich 1 fought a slipping blue incline belt overnight — tensioning nuts backed off, maintenance ordered locking collars and fixed by 08:53.
per_plant_summary.L2: FFS ran HER 5.1oz rolls but needed frequent shoulder cleaning for smudges — down 09:26 to 09:31, then again at 11:19 for bags not opening, cleared by 11:40. Low weight kickoffs (6 bars instead of 7) were the biggest quality concern; speed dropped from 90 to 80 ppm at 10:30 to reduce rejects. ML2 ran FEA with scheduled CILs every shift; flow-wrap rollers jammed at 11:01, maintenance cleared by 11:19. ML3 vibration section 2 failed at startup (05:23), turned off and depositing started at 05:35; label splicing issues overnight on 2nd shift, but 1st shift ran 4 clean splices with no trouble.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle Line's Cavanna 1 had a door safety switch taped instead of bolted (corrected at 07:29), then roller issues flagged at 09:51 with maintenance still working through accumulated product at 11:38. Metal detector belt shifted 1.5 inches and was corrected by 10:24. ML4 had a strong overnight — 1,746 cases, highest of the week — but TG3 splitter needed parameter adjustments at 07:28 (running good by 07:43) and a gondola jam at 06:10 cleared by 06:31. Molds jumping at conveyor 1 were traced to chain phasing out of sync; WDS scheduled onsite fix. MF Matrix belt B jammed at 16:41 on 9/22 with no resolution posted.

notes.text: Erandy marked the Sollich 1 Sweco sifters with orientation marks and reminded teams to reassemble in exact position after cleaning.
Hansel updated all Sollich 2 checklists to include cleaning 90-degree elbows to prevent mold buildup.
Troy replaced the SD card in MM3 printer to fix freezing issue; teams asked to report if it reoccurs.
Grey color-coded and labeled Cavanna 1 and 2 glycol hose connections to prevent misassembly; added to startup checklist.
Chad announced firewall upgrade at 12:30 today with brief internet outage; teams to reboot if Wi-Fi issues after install.
German found unreal mint patties in warehouse aisle 1 section 33B.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 blue incline conveyor slipping
resolved.summary: Blue belt skipping overnight; tensioner found loose, speed reduced to 62.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 08:53 — "Tensioning nuts backed off causing the belt to slip. Matt is ordering locking collars to prevent this from happening again" (Curt Willis). Speed returned to 72.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 THG metal parts colliding
resolved.summary: Two metal parts from THG hitting each other at 05:38, line down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:38 — "maintenance fixed it and line is running again" (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 ultrasonic cutter stopped
resolved.summary: Cutter stopped at 11:03; maintenance performed a reset and the line started running again.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:17 — "Maintenance performed a reset, and we started running the line again" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Matrix 5 pouches not opening
resolved.summary: Matrix 5 pouches failing to open at 08:59; Troy working on adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 09:16 — "inside top suction cups were too high and not providing a good seal...dropped them by 2mm and it has solved the issue" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: ML3 vibration section 2 failure at startup
resolved.summary: Vibration section 2 problem prevented depositing at 05:23, maintenance working.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:35 — "turn off vibration 2 section" (Alex), "started depositing at 5:35 am" (Filler).

resolved.title: FFS line down for shoulder cleaning
resolved.summary: Smudges on pouches at 09:26, line stopped to clean the shoulder.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:31 — "Line is back up" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 flow-wrap rollers jammed
resolved.summary: Flow-wrap rollers problem at 11:01, maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:19 — "The line is running" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: FFS bags not opening properly
resolved.summary: Bags failing to open at 11:19, line down.

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 down with 413 error
resolved.summary: TG3 went down at 16:07 with 413 error, all sensors referencing 0.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:38 — "Line is back up and running" (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML4 mold crash at pre-heating 2
resolved.summary: Mold crash at pre-heating 2 at 19:56, jams being cleared.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:42 — "Mold jams are cleared...Line is up and running now" (Shane/Marcos).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola jammed with chocolate
resolved.summary: Gondola jammed with chocolate at 06:10, line down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:31 — "Line is back up running at 25 mpm" (ML4 WDS).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 splitter timing issue
resolved.summary: TG3 down since 07:15 for splitter adjustment, Kavin working on parameter settings.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 07:43 — "I adjusted the splitter settings...TG3 running good" (Kavin Ayala). Adjusted factor for synchronous speed from 1420 to 1380 and beginning of let through range from 1372 to 1350.

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 1 door safety switch taped
resolved.summary: Door safety switch held on by tape prevented startup; corrected with bolts.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 07:29 — "corrected the issue by using bolts and it should no longer be a problem" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle Line metal detector belt shifted
resolved.summary: Metal detector belt moved about 1.5 inches to south side at 10:09.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 10:24 — "metal detector belt has been moved back to the correct position" (Rich Brierley).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 THG finger broke, dark caramel, and tunnel 1 issues
needs_attention.summary: THG finger broke at 23:56 stopping wrapping; level 2 clean ordered. Dark caramel flagged at 03:05 and placed on hold. Watery batch with unmixed sugar found at 05:41. Metal spatula pulled into slitter at 06:13 requiring blade replacement. Tunnel 1 belt found dirty with rails misaligned at 08:30.
needs_attention.status: Slitter blades replaced by 06:49 and line running by 07:17. Tunnel 1 rails being corrected as of 08:30. Dark caramel on hold. THG finger replacement and level 2 clean completion not confirmed by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 Belt C1 and Matrix 8 belt issues
needs_attention.summary: Belt C1 reported stopping at 09:55 and Matrix 8 belt not working at 10:37, both with maintenance called; Justin asked for update at 10:44 with no follow-up posted.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called on both belts as of 10:37; no resolution or status update posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS low weight kickoffs with 6 bars per pouch
needs_attention.summary: Line producing pouches with only 6 bars instead of 7 since morning; maintenance troubleshooting, speed reduced from 90 to 80 ppm at 10:30 to reduce rejects.
needs_attention.status: Speed adjustment made at 10:30, monitoring hourly. Root cause not identified as of 11:51.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 magnet and plate not heating
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 4 magnet and plate not heating up at 14:48 on 9/22; bolts found missing on south side, maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Issue identified with missing bolts at 14:48 on 9/22; no resolution or follow-up posted through end of window.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix belt B jammed on conveyor
needs_attention.summary: Belt B jamming at 16:36 on 9/22, hitting top metal part; maintenance informed.
needs_attention.status: Belt jammed as of 16:41 on 9/22; no resolution or status update posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 molds jumping at conveyor 1 — chain phasing issue
needs_attention.summary: Molds jumping rather than smooth transition into conveyor 1 after long loop at 05:15; WDS diagnosed chain phasing out of sync with servo drive timing.
needs_attention.status: WDS identified phasing issue; Marcel scheduled to correct synchronization and train maintenance during onsite visit. Line running but issue unresolved.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 1 roller issues
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna 1 roller not working flagged at 09:51; maintenance adjusting. Accumulated product being transferred via Cavanna 2 as of 11:38.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance continues working on Cavanna 1 rollers as of 11:38; accumulated material being run through Cavanna 2 while work in progress.
